dialogue_segments.label: RUPERT (Defensive, Anxious)
dialogue_segments.speaker: RUPERT
dialogue_segments.text: The Ashcroft girl is locked tight. Nobody knows she is down there.

dialogue_segments.label: ELDER NOBLEMAN (Stern, Disapproving)
dialogue_segments.speaker: ELDER NOBLEMAN
dialogue_segments.text: The kitchen maids are whispering. They see the soup bowls returned unwiped. They see your guards outside the lower grates.

dialogue_segments.label: RUPERT (Muttered, Paranoid)
dialogue_segments.speaker: RUPERT
dialogue_segments.text: She knows the Duchess was poisoned.

dialogue_segments.label: RUPERT (Fearful)
dialogue_segments.speaker: RUPERT
dialogue_segments.text: If she speaks...

dialogue_segments.label: ELDER NOBLEMAN (Fierce, Venomous)
dialogue_segments.speaker: ELDER NOBLEMAN
dialogue_segments.text: Then make certain she isn't! A peasant weed, Rupert! You do not store weeds in your cellar, you burn them!

dialogue_segments.label: RUPERT (Faltering, Submissive)
dialogue_segments.speaker: RUPERT
dialogue_segments.text: What are you suggesting?

dialogue_segments.label: ELDER NOBLEMAN (Calculated, Ominous)
dialogue_segments.speaker: ELDER NOBLEMAN
dialogue_segments.text: We stop hiding the prisoner.

dialogue_segments.label: ELDER NOBLEMAN (Deadpan, Sinister)
dialogue_segments.speaker: ELDER NOBLEMAN
dialogue_segments.text: We give them a reason to condemn her.

dialogue_segments.label: CATHERINE (Inquiring, Sharp)
dialogue_segments.speaker: CATHERINE
dialogue_segments.text: You have a solution?

dialogue_segments.label: ELDER NOBLEMAN (Ruthless)
dialogue_segments.speaker: ELDER NOBLEMAN
dialogue_segments.text: We use the law to destroy her.

dialogue_segments.label: RUPERT (Confused)
dialogue_segments.speaker: RUPERT
dialogue_segments.text: The law?

dialogue_segments.label: ELDER NOBLEMAN (Pragmatic, Scheming)
dialogue_segments.speaker: ELDER NOBLEMAN
dialogue_segments.text: A maid with herbs in her possession, a secret medicine, an unauthorized visit to the Duchess's chamber.

dialogue_segments.label: ELDER NOBLEMAN (Cold, Calculating)
dialogue_segments.speaker: ELDER NOBLEMAN
dialogue_segments.text: Give those facts to a magistrate in the right order, and she becomes a poisoner.

dialogue_segments.label: CATHERINE (Curious, Conniving)

dialogue_segments.label: ELDER NOBLEMAN (Sinister)

dialogue_segments.text: Then call it witchcraft.

dialogue_segments.label: RUPERT (Stunned)
dialogue_segments.speaker: RUPERT
dialogue_segments.text: Witchcraft is a capital charge.

dialogue_segments.label: ELDER NOBLEMAN (Unflinching)
dialogue_segments.speaker: ELDER NOBLEMAN
dialogue_segments.text: Precisely.

dialogue_segments.label: ELDER NOBLEMAN (Authoritative, Command)
dialogue_segments.speaker: ELDER NOBLEMAN
dialogue_segments.text: Do not hide the evidence, manufacture it. Drag her before the magistrate tomorrow, frame the trial, buy the jury, and let the State hang her.

logline: When rumors of the poisoned Duchess begin spreading among the servants, Rupert and Catherine conspire with an elder nobleman to fabricate a witchcraft charge against Juliana, sealing her fate for the gallows.
continuity_notes: Follows directly from Episode 29 where Juliana was locked away in the castle's subterranean wet cells, vowing never to let them take Alexander from her.

dialogue_segments.label: ELDER NOBLEMAN (Dismissive)
dialogue_segments.speaker: ELDER NOBLEMAN
dialogue_segments.text: She is weak, confused. No magistrate will trust a dying woman's accusations against a respected household.

dialogue_segments.label: RUPERT (Hesitant)
dialogue_segments.speaker: RUPERT
dialogue_segments.text: And Juliana?

dialogue_segments.label: ELDER NOBLEMAN (Cold, Resolute)
dialogue_segments.speaker: ELDER NOBLEMAN
dialogue_segments.text: She goes before the magistrate tomorrow.

dialogue_segments.label: CATHERINE (Cruel, Exultant)
dialogue_segments.speaker: CATHERINE
dialogue_segments.text: She will hang. A perfect solution. The town will cheer as the witch's disgraced daughter faces the noose.

dialogue_segments.label: RUPERT (Resolute, Vengeful)
dialogue_segments.speaker: RUPERT
dialogue_segments.text: I will write the arrest warrant myself.

dialogue_segments.label: ELDER NOBLEMAN (Chilling, Decisive)
dialogue_segments.speaker: ELDER NOBLEMAN
dialogue_segments.text: Tomorrow, she stops being a prisoner. She becomes a witch.

action_segments.label: ACTION
action_segments.text: Juliana clutches a rough burlap rag to her trembling chest, her tear-stained face lifting upward in dread and fragile hope as the frame holds, cutting abruptly to black.
